# The function names a formula of a file spells with a prefix, as test data for `FUTURE` and
# `WORKSHEET_ONLY` in `src/xlsx_formula_text.rs`. One name per line, `[section]` headers.
#
# Source of [spec], [plain], [worksheet]: [MS-XLSX] 2.2.2 Formulas, rules `future-function-list`
# and `worksheet-only-function-list` (copied 2026-11-14 from the published specification page).
#   [spec]       names inside the `"_xlfn."` group of the rule: written `_xlfn.NAME`.
#   [plain]      names the rule lists outside that group: written as they are.
#   [worksheet]  written `_xlfn._xlws.NAME`.
#   [observed]   names the rule does not list as future functions, or lists outside the group,
#                that files of the spreadsheet application nevertheless carry with `_xlfn.`
#                (the dynamic array helpers, the 2016 and 2019 additions, the forecast family).
#                They are test data of this table only; a name found in [spec] never repeats here.
